access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2VyaV9wb3dlQGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsImV4cCI6MTY4NDQxMjA5OH0._rf8__dV4TpIqH9G7bsomESGf0HrUBa_zORTmv0bKHg'

candidates = [{'artist_id': 14, 'name': 'Grace Harrison', 'follower_count': 22}]

for c in candidates:
    artist_id = c['artist_id']
    already = apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=artist_id, access_token=access_token)['following']
    print('artist', artist_id, c['name'], 'already_following', already)
    if not already:
        res = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=artist_id, access_token=access_token)
        print('follow_result', res)

print('<reflection>Entry [abc123] guided us to verify following status and then follow only unfollowed artists; action executed.</reflection>')
